days.title: Glacial Lakes and Iceberg Tongues

stops.name: Breiðamerkurjökull
stops.detail: Jökulsárlón is known for the icebergs floating on it, which break off from the glacier tongue of Breiðamerkurjökull and reach heights of up to 15 meters.

stops.name: Fjallsárlón
stops.detail: Nearby are two other glacial lakes, the much smaller and more remote Fjallsárlón, with smaller icebergs, as well as the Breiðárlón.

stops.name: Jökulsá á Breiðamerkursandi
stops.detail: The short river from this lake to the sea is called Jökulsá á Breiðamerkursandi, just as many other rivers in Iceland are called Jökulsá ("glacier river").

stops.name: Diamantstrand
stops.detail: When the current is directed seaward, icebergs are washed out of the lake into the sea and partly deposited on the adjacent black basalt sand beach, which is why it is sometimes called Diamond Beach.
